title: Optimization of De-EscalatiON strategies in early breast cancer
official: Optimization of De-EscalatiON strategies in early breast cancer
summary:
Main objective: TNBC e HER2+: of a response-adapted de-escalated neoadjuvant strategy in achieving pathological complete response (pCR).
Diagnostic performance of post-neoadjuvant assessment (breast MRI plus confirmatory image-guided biopsy) in predicting absence of residual disease
HR+/HER2−: Efficacy of a risk-adapted therapeutic strategy.
Description of the distribution of patients across the three OncotypeDX genomic risk categories (low, intermediate, high).

interventions.name: Tamoxifene-ratiopharm 20 mg compresse rivestite con film
Docetaxel 80 mg/4 ml concentrate for solution for infusion
FARMORUBICINA 50 mg Polvere per Soluzione per Infusione
KEYTRUDA 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion.
Ogivri 420 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion
Paclitaxel 6 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion
Perjeta 420 mg concentrate for solution for infusion
Carboplatin-Teva 10 mg/ml Concentrate for Solution for Infusion
Kadcyla 160 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion.
Endoxan Baxter 1 g Polvere per soluzione iniettabile

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥18  ECOG 0–1 Histologically confirmed: -TNBC: ER/PgR <10%, HER2−  -HER2+: per ASCO/CAP  -HR+: ER and/or PgR ≥10%, HER2−.  AJCC 8th edition stage I*, II or IIIa (excl. T4/N3) Willingness to undergo breast MRI/US and VAB biopsy Informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. N3 and/or T4, including inflammatory BC Contraindications to chemotherapy or radiotherapy (if indicated) Significant organ dysfunctions Pregnancy/breastfeeding Severe autoimmune disease Active HIV/HBV/HCV infection
